text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, I won! Even against those two, 
I—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable... To think that two members 
of the Mejiro family would concede first 
place...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly believe it... I thought 
victory was assured with those two, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but I will seize 
glory next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Surely McQueen feels the exact same way! 
She will live up to everyone's 
expectations! And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only one in the Mejiro 
family! I'll make sure to show everyone 
that Mejiro Ryan is here too, right at the 
Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right!! That's right, isn't 
it, Ryan-sama! I will continue to support 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If I had finished in Ryan-chan's place, 
would words like that have come out of my 
mouth right away?)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(How will the fans feel about my results? 
Did I even think as far as how to follow 
up with them?)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...I definitely couldn't do that. I 
would've made a frustrated face for sure. 
That's probably the difference between me 
and Ryan-chan right now.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...That is what an Umamusume who carries 
expectations looks like.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to, in the Takarazuka Kinen...!

At the center of the winner's circle, Ines 
Fujin placed a hand over her heart and 
made a vow.
